email.subject: AI for Dorf Nelson & Zauderer LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jon,

Congratulations on Dorf Nelson & Zauderer's ranking in Chambers and Partners' Spotlight New York 2026 guide for Commercial Litigation. Your team's reputation for handling complex disputes is exactly why I'm reaching out.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping litigation teams compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
